A command to check a converted model against its original. No API or `.knx` format changes.

## New

**`tools/verify.py`**
```bash
python tools/verify.py model.h5     model.knx [--input x.npy] [--batch 64] [--tol 1e-4] [--ane]
python tools/verify.py model.tflite model.knx
python tools/verify.py model.pt     model.knx
```
- Feeds the same input to the original model (Keras, TFLite or PyTorch) and to KERNIX. Prints the maximum relative error (`max|a-b| / max|a|`), the prediction (argmax) agreement, and the time for batch 1 and the full batch (median of 20 after warm-up).
- Exit code 1 when the error exceeds `--tol` (default 1e-4), so it can run in CI. For int8 models and `--ane` (float16), raise `--tol` yourself; it is never loosened automatically.
- `--input` takes a `.npy` whose first axis is the batch. Without it, 64 standard-normal samples (seed 0) are used. Agreement only means something on real data. Models with integer inputs (Embedding) need `--input`.
- Only the framework for the given extension is imported. `.tflite` files run one sample at a time.

## Results (Apple M1, sign language models from README section 7, random input)

| Original | Max relative error | Agreement | Batch 64: original → KERNIX |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Fingerspelling LSTM, Keras `.h5` | 3.9e-7 | 100% | 10.5 → 0.24 ms |
| Fingerspelling LSTM, `.tflite` | 4.5e-7 | 100% | 2.3 → 0.25 ms |
| Word LSTM, Keras `.h5` | 2.1e-6 | 100% | 61 → 2.4 ms |

The int8 fingerspelling `.knx` fails the default tolerance against TFLite (98.4% agreement) and passes with `--tol 1e-1`. This is expected for int8 weights.

Not yet supported: `.tflite` files whose inputs are quantized to int8.
